results.title: The Costs & Value of ADA WCAG Compliance for SaaS Providers - Accessibility.Works
results.snippet: Most engagements run $30,000-$60,000 for a complete cycle including audit, remediation consulting, verification, and VPAT. Simpler platforms can start in the low $20Ks; complex enterprise platforms can reach six figures.

results.title: Accessibility Services Pricing Page | Accessible.org
results.snippet: Accessible.org web accessibility audits cost $100 – $250 per page (or screen) and $25 – $100 for light pages/screens. Our audits follow best practices for ADA and EAA compliance.
